 Darius Garland Scores 13 Points In Loss To Suns 
 Darius Garland put up 13 points and six assists as the Los Angeles Clippers lost 133-110 to the Phoenix Suns on Tuesday.
 What It Means
 The Clippers will now face the Philadelphia 76ers on the road on Tuesday.
